description:
Pull requests prove the consolidated runtime and the OCI/archive/attestation/copy machinery is fixture-tested before freeze, but no v1 OCI candidate or release tag is created.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Pull requests build without pushing and runtime-smoke default 10001:10001 plus host-owner UID:GID mapping, PID 1 signal shutdown, / and /api/health routing, WORKDIR /repo, an initialized /repo mount, seeded issue and linked-document /api/search results, host-visible persistence, and clear failure on an incompatible owner/mode.
- [hard] REQ-02: Main pushes publish only :main and :sha-<commit>; no pull request or release-candidate job assigns :latest, major, minor, full-version, split-component, or CLI image tags.
- [hard] REQ-03: The local candidate producer requires the immutable envelope before Buildx. A release-tool manifest pins Buildx, BuildKit, Skopeo, Podman, and the OCI Distribution registry by version/digest and defines one Linux/amd64 type=oci tar with source/revision/version labels, provenance=max, SBOM=true, and no load/repack.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fixtures parse a representative archive into tar SHA-256, D_index, D_run and descriptor inventory; require runnable/max-provenance/SPDX subjects; copy D_run to rootless Podman with preserved digest; and round-trip the full index to a disposable registry with --all --preserve-digests.
- [hard] REQ-05: The shared harness rejects push permission on pull requests, v1 tag mutation, missing identity preflight, digest/descriptor/subject changes, and runtime failure. Completion verifies GHCR :1.0.0 and any v1 OCI candidate remain absent; only workflow/tooling/fixtures land.

## Notes

Blast radius: Docker workflow definitions, pinned Buildx/BuildKit/Skopeo/Podman setup, OCI structure/copy/runtime fixtures, and harness declarations; exact v1 OCI execution occurs after source freeze.
title: Implement OCI candidate producer tooling
